lessons.title: Decoder architecture & efficient attention
lessons.conceptOverview: A decoder predicts the next token under a causal mask. RoPE encodes relative position through rotations; RMSNorm rescales activations and SwiGLU gates feed-forward features. MQA shares one key/value head and GQA shares them within groups, reducing KV-cache memory. The cache stores previous keys and values during decoding.

lessons.title: Pretraining, tokenization & scaling
lessons.conceptOverview: A tokenizer maps text into a vocabulary of token IDs. Pretraining minimizes next-token cross entropy over large text corpora. Deduplication, quality filtering and held-out contamination checks are part of the data pipeline. Compute/data scaling tradeoffs compare parameter count and training tokens under a fixed budget, rather than assuming larger is always better.

lessons.title: Post-training & model families
lessons.conceptOverview: SFT learns from instruction-response examples. RLHF uses preference feedback, often through a reward model; DPO optimizes relative preference directly. MoE activates a subset of experts per token, so active compute differs from total parameter memory. Compare GPT, Llama, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek and Mistral using model cards for the specific release: architecture, context, license, modalities and evaluations vary.
